title: 8 Best Cash Positioning Software Tools in 2026
summary: Compare the 8 best cash positioning software tools in 2026, from Kyriba and GTreasury to AI agents like Concourse, by bank connectivity, fit, and cost.
body_markdown:
Cash positioning is the most basic question in treasury and one of the hardest to answer well: how much cash do we have right now, across every bank, account, entity, and currency. When cash is spread across a dozen banking portals and a few spreadsheets, building that position by hand eats the first hours of every morning. **Cash positioning software** exists to make the answer real-time and trustworthy.


It is still a surprisingly unsolved problem. PwC's 2025 Global Treasury Survey,[cited by Agicap](https://agicap.com/en/article/cash-positioning-software/) , found only 17% of treasurers have complete, near-real-time visibility into their group's cash position. This guide compares the eight best cash positioning software tools in 2026, from enterprise connectivity platforms to AI agents that build the position for you. Positioning is the foundation; once you have it,[cash forecasting](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/best-cash-forecasting-tools) is the next step.


## **What is the best cash positioning software?**


> The best cash positioning software depends on your scale and bank mix. Concourse is the pick for teams that want AI agents to build and reconcile the daily cash position automatically, not just display it. For the broadest bank connectivity at global scale it is Kyriba and GTreasury; for modern API-native visibility, Trovata; for managed multi-bank connectivity, Nomentia and Cobase; for an AI-native newcomer, Panax; and for European mid-market, Agicap.


> **Concourse is the AI-agent option on this list.** Rather than a dashboard you read, Concourse deploys finance agents that connect to your banks and ERP, pull balances and transactions, classify the flows, and produce the daily cash position, with every number traceable back to source. It is built for teams that want the position built and reconciled for them, and the same agents run forecasting and reporting on top.


## **What makes good cash positioning software**


Cash positioning is a connectivity and trust problem before it is a dashboard problem. We compared the tools on what actually determines whether you get a reliable position each morning:


- **Bank connectivity breadth.** How many banks it connects to and how automatically balances and transactions flow in, across SWIFT, host-to-host, EBICS, and API.
- **Real-time and intraday.** Whether the position is prior-day only or updates intraday as activity posts.
- **Transaction classification.** How much of the categorization is automated versus manual.
- **Multi-entity and multi-currency.** Rolling up cash across entities and currencies into one position.
- **Execution, not just display.** Whether it simply shows the position or also builds, reconciles, and acts on it.
- **Time to value.** How fast you can connect your banks and trust the number.

## **The 8 best cash positioning software tools in 2026**


### **1. Concourse, Best for AI Agents That Build the Position**


Concourse is an AI agent platform for corporate finance. Instead of a dashboard an analyst assembles the position in, its agents connect to your banks and ERP, pull prior-day and intraday balances and transactions, classify the flows, and produce the daily cash position, with a person approving. Every figure traces back to the source bank and ERP data and is validated against evals built for your business, so the position is defensible, not just displayed.


The difference is execution and breadth. Concourse builds and reconciles the position rather than leaving that work to you, and the same agent layer runs cash forecasting, variance, and reporting on top. It is SOC 2 Type II certified and connects to 100+ systems including NetSuite, QuickBooks, Snowflake, Salesforce, and Stripe. This is the cash-desk work we describe in[the AI treasury analyst](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/ai-treasury-analyst) .


**Best for.** Teams that want the daily cash position built and reconciled automatically, with forecasting and reporting from the same agents.


**Keep in mind.** Concourse is an agent layer, not a dedicated SWIFT bank-connectivity network. For the very broadest out-of-the-box multi-bank coverage, it can run alongside or connect to the banks directly.


### **2. Kyriba, Best for the Broadest Bank Connectivity**


Kyriba is the enterprise standard for global cash visibility, built on one of the largest bank-connectivity networks in the market. Its[connectivity page claims 10,000+ banks and 73,000+ format scenarios](https://www.kyriba.com/products/connectivity/) , aggregating balances and transactions into a single real-time position for large, multi-entity treasuries.


**Best for.** Global enterprises with many banking relationships that need broad, out-of-the-box connectivity.


**Keep in mind.** It is enterprise-grade in cost and implementation, and often more than a smaller team needs for daily positioning. See our[Kyriba pricing](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/kyriba-pricing) breakdown.


### **3. GTreasury, Best for Enterprise Single-Platform Treasury**


GTreasury combines real-time cash positioning with forecasting, in-house banking, and reconciliation on one SaaS platform, and was[named a Leader in the 2025-2026 IDC MarketScape for AI-enabled treasury and risk applications](https://www.gtreasury.com/posts/idc-marketscape-ai-enabled-enterprise-treasury-risk-2025-2026-report) . In late 2025 Ripple agreed to acquire GTreasury, and the product now also sits under the Ripple Treasury brand.


**Best for.** Enterprises consolidating cash, payments, and risk on one governed platform.


**Keep in mind.** With the Ripple acquisition still integrating, evaluate the current roadmap alongside the legacy product.


### **4. Trovata, Best for Modern API-Native Visibility**


Trovata is a cloud, API-native platform focused on real-time multi-bank cash visibility and reporting, giving mid-market teams current positioning without a heavy enterprise implementation. It has[raised around $80 million, including from State Street and PNC](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/trovata-buys-treasury-software-fundraises-from-pnc-bank) , with customers including Square and Etsy.


**Best for.** Mid-market teams that want fast, modern, multi-bank cash visibility.


**Keep in mind.** Its depth in the most complex enterprise scenarios still trails the incumbents. We compared it directly in[Concourse vs. Trovata](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/concourse-vs-trovata) .


### **5. Nomentia, Best for Managed Multi-Bank Connectivity**


Nomentia is a European-rooted treasury suite whose strength is managed multi-bank connectivity for daily cash management across entities and currencies. It[connects to 10,000+ banks as a SWIFT-certified partner and operates in 80+ countries serving around 1,400 clients](https://www.nomentia.com/smart-treasury-suite/connect) .


**Best for.** European mid-market to enterprise teams that want managed bank connections plus payments.


**Keep in mind.** Strongest in Europe, and it is a broader suite than a pure positioning point tool.


### **6. Cobase, Best for Fragmented Multi-Bank Visibility**


Cobase is a dedicated multi-bank connectivity platform that brings balances, statements, and transactions across banks and entities into one dashboard, aimed squarely at the core positioning use case. It[combines SWIFT, host-to-host, EBICS, and API connectivity across 90+ countries](https://www.cobase.com/insight-hub/cobase-centralizes-cash-visibility-and-payment-management) , and is now part of Corpay.


**Best for.** Companies whose primary pain is fragmented cash visibility across many banks.


**Keep in mind.** Now integrated into Corpay, so evaluate it within that broader offering.


### **7. Panax, Best for an AI-Native Newcomer**


Panax is an AI-native cash management platform that consolidates balances directly from banks and ERPs into a unified real-time position, with AI transaction categorization, aimed at lean teams that want fast time-to-value. Founded in 2022, it[raised a $15 million round in 2024 led by Team8 and TLV Partners](https://fintech.global/2024/05/09/ai-powered-panax-raises-15m-to-reshape-cash-flow-management/) .


**Best for.** Mid-market teams with multiple banks and entities that want modern positioning without a heavy TMS.


**Keep in mind.** It is a young, smaller company, and leans into forecasting as well as positioning.


### **8. Agicap, Best for European SMB and Mid-Market**


Agicap is an all-in-one cash management platform with a dedicated cash positioning capability, giving SMB and mid-market teams real-time balances and flows across accounts and entities. It[raised a EUR 45 million Series C in 2024](https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/11/agicap-secures-48-million-for-its-cash-flow-management-platform/) and serves 8,000+ clients, positioning itself as Europe's leading cash flow management provider for smaller companies.


**Best for.** European SMB and mid-market teams that want fast, self-serve cash visibility.


**Keep in mind.** More SMB and mid-market oriented than a heavy enterprise connectivity engine, and strongest in Europe.


## **Which cash positioning software is right for you?**


Match the tool to your scale and bank mix:


- **Choose Concourse** if you want AI agents to *build and reconcile* the daily position automatically, with forecasting and reporting from the same layer.
- **Choose Kyriba or GTreasury** if you are a global enterprise that needs the broadest bank connectivity on a governed platform.
- **Choose Trovata** if you want modern, API-native multi-bank visibility for the mid-market.
- **Choose Nomentia or Cobase** if managed multi-bank connectivity is your core need.
- **Choose Panax** if you want a modern, AI-native tool with fast time-to-value.
- **Choose Agicap** if you are a European SMB or mid-market team.


The pattern in 2026 is a split between tools that *show* you the position and tools that *build* it. The connectivity platforms aggregate the data beautifully; the AI-agent layer takes the next step and assembles, reconciles, and explains the position for you.


## **Frequently asked questions**


### **What is cash positioning software?**


Cash positioning software gives a company real-time, consolidated visibility into its current cash across every bank account, entity, and currency. It aggregates balances and transactions, classifies them, and produces the daily cash position, distinct from cash forecasting, which predicts future cash.


### **What is the difference between cash positioning and cash forecasting?**


Cash positioning is about the present: how much cash you have right now across all banks. Cash forecasting is about the future: how much you expect to have. Positioning is the foundation, because a forecast is only as good as the current position it starts from. Many tools do both; some specialize.


### **What is the best cash positioning software?**


It depends on scale and bank mix. Kyriba and GTreasury lead enterprise connectivity, Trovata leads modern API-native visibility, Nomentia and Cobase lead managed multi-bank connectivity, and for teams that want AI agents to build and reconcile the position automatically, Concourse is the strongest AI-agent option.


## **The bottom line**


The best cash positioning software depends on how many banks you run and how much of the work you want done for you. Connectivity-first platforms like Kyriba, GTreasury, Nomentia, and Cobase aggregate cash across banks; modern tools like Trovata, Panax, and Agicap make it fast and self-serve. The newer shift is an AI-agent layer that does not just show the position but builds and reconciles it.
